name: Cathilia's Meddling
disable: DC 21 Hellknight Lore check (trained) to convince the Hellknight that she's adding to chaos, or DC 25 Diplomacy check to request she stop yelling
routine: (3 actions) Cathilia uses her Hellknight's Orders Strike on creatures engaged in open fighting in area A2. She randomly chooses between targets in the likely case that there are multiple combatants.

items.name: Stop, Burglar
items.text:
Trigger A creature other than Zefiro opens the Museum's gates

---
Effect Cathilia shouts at the triggering creature. The target must succeed at a DC 27 Will save save or have their action disrupted, and then Cathilia's meddling rolls initiative.

text: A Hellknight on horseback shouts commands, beseeching all to return to order.
